name: Pingboard
author: nixfred
description: Live latency, jitter and loss to your gateway, the internet, DNS and your tailnet hosts, with a verdict that says where the problem is: LAN, ISP, DNS or tailnet.

barWidget.description: A health dot and the internet round trip in ms. Click for per-target sparklines, loss, jitter and the LAN / ISP / DNS / tailnet verdict.

schema.label: Probe interval (seconds)
schema.description: One ping per target per interval. 5 s is about 0.2 KB/s total.

schema.label: Tailnet hosts
schema.description: Comma-separated tailnet machine names to watch, resolved via tailscale ip.

schema.label: Show ms on the bar
schema.description: Internet round trip beside the dot. Off leaves just the dot.
